correctness.rationale: For q any prime power and n>=2, rank-one and rank-two additive averages on uniform GL_n equal -u and v=ut by direct first-two-column counting. The exact rook tensor formula gives all five eigenspaces and multiplicities; all positive by elementary scalar inequalities and variance of zero-entry count. The exact polynomial evaluation at I has sign (2q-n)-(q-1)(n-2)t, strictly positive below n=2q and negative from that dimension, proving both sharp endpoint sectors. The fixed-q asymptotic expands a 2x2 root. A standalone checker exactly enumerated seven finite cases including GF4 and checked 138 crossover signs; it is supportive, not infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Exact additive Fourier moments on GL_n are known (Li–Hu, Theorem 2.1); the contribution instead solves the complete selected-band Gram eigenproblem with sharp equality spaces, proves the exact n=2q upper-sector transition and its exponential near-tightness. The two most relevant published Fourier-frame classifications concern a different rank-one shell or n=2 determinant-one sampling, and none of the inspected statements covers the full new theorem. Historical equivalent reformulations remain possible.

Li–Hu 2011 gives the complete low-rank Fourier-moment ingredients; only the new spectral ordering, equality spaces and asymptotic are claimed beyond that literature.
The exact q=2,n=2 case is already included in the published determinant-one Fourier-frame result.

value.rationale: This is a full classification of a natural finite-group sampling operator, giving exact sharp Riesz bounds with a nontrivial switch in the extremizing mode at dimension n=2q. It demonstrates exponential near-tightness even when the sampling set has nonvanishing complement density. The result is motivated by stable Fourier coefficient reconstruction and does not reduce to an isolated small case, a known rank-one table, or a rebranding of the known Gauss sums.
